cohort: The study included 120 paediatric patients (65 males, 55 females) with a mean age of 6.4 years who had asthma and allergic rhinitis.
finding: The study found significant associations between childhood asthma and allergic rhinitis and several genetic (CD14 polymorphisms) and environmental factors, including age, weight status, personal history of allergies, and various household and lifestyle exposures.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was significantly more prevalent in paediatric patients with asthma and allergic rhinitis.
